# Getting Support for Refractor UI

Welcome to the **Refractor Optical Glass UI Kit** community! Here is the fastest way to get help:

- **Interactive Documentation & Live Playground:** https://sourcecode.github.io/refractor-ui/
- **Getting Started & Theming Guides:** https://sourcecode.github.io/refractor-ui/#/getting-started
- **Questions, Showcases & Ideas:** Open a thread in [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/SourceCode/refractor-ui/discussions).
- **Bug Reports & Component Proposals:** File a structured issue using our [GitHub Issue Templates](https://github.com/SourceCode/refractor-ui/issues/new/choose).
- **Security Vulnerabilities:** Please **do not** file a public issue. Follow [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md) and report privately through GitHub Security Advisories.
